instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the page strictly delivers an Awwwards-level dark theme experience using #0B0E17 as the main background.
Use Electric Blue (#2563EB) and Electric Cyan (#00D2FF) for highlights, borders, and interactive states.
Ensure all interactive buttons, links, inputs, and cards include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-link-sobre', data-testid='project-card-vagas-tapajos').
Implement full Portuguese text exactly as defined in the user prompt.
Ensure mobile responsiveness is flawless: stack grid columns, hide custom cursor on touch, preserve touch button targets.
Include project detail modals or expanders for 'Detalhes' clicks on project cards to present full feature breakdowns.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: All buttons, navigation links, tech cards, project cards, social links, and form inputs MUST include explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case format.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays_rule: Header and sticky bars must have backdrop-blur with opaque or semi-opaque dark tint (#0B0E17 with 80% opacity minimum) to avoid overlapping text unreadability.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do not apply transition: all globally. Apply targeted CSS transitions to color, background-color, border-color, and opacity only.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.typography_rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) and mono overlines must use tracking-[0.25em].
